chunks.text: DEMO TEXT (not clinical advice). Assess asthma control by daytime symptoms, night waking, reliever use, and activity limitation. Uncontrolled symptoms should trigger a review of inhaler technique and adherence before stepping up therapy.

DEMO TEXT (not clinical advice). Inhaled corticosteroids are the usual maintenance backbone in persistent asthma pathways. Check spacer use and rinse-after-steroid counselling when reviewing a regimen.

DEMO TEXT (not clinical advice). For a moderate exacerbation in this sample pathway, increase reliever frequency, review maintenance dosing, and look for infection or trigger exposure. Severe distress is an emergency referral, not an index-only problem.
DEMO TEXT (not clinical advice). Refer if diagnosis is uncertain, if control stays poor on medium-dose ICS/LABA, or if there are life-threatening features. This sample is for retrieval plumbing only.
DEMO TEXT (not clinical advice). Give a written action plan covering daily inhalers, how to recognise worsening, and when to seek urgent care. Confirm the patient can demonstrate inhaler technique.
